item.title: The 31st FRUCT conference news 3
item.description: We are proudly announcing that the Future Internet journal (Sitescore 4.1 Scopus, Q2) is a patron of the 31st FRUCT conference. A special issue of the journal will be prepared and released shortly. The best conference papers will be invited to publish extended version of the paper in the main issues, as well as in the Special Issue of the Future Internet Journal. We enougare all authors to use this opportunity.

item.title: The 31st FRUCT conference news 2
item.description: Authors of the 31st FRUCT conference are welcome to submit the extended versions of the conference papers to the Special Issue of the Future Internet journal (twitter, LinkedIn). You can learn more about this opportunity here. For further questions regarding your contributions to the Special issue please contact directly Prof. Dr. Vijayakumar Varadarajan, the Guest Editor of the Special Issue.

item.title: The 31st FRUCT conference news 1
item.description: We proudly announce that Heli Helskyaho from Miracle Oy (Finland) will give the conference keynote talk on Automated Machine Learning and Machine Learning Services.
